q.q: At what time between 5 and 6 o'clock do the hands of a clock first form a right angle?
q.e: Hands are 90° apart when |6m − (30h + 0.5m)| = 90; take the earliest solution.

q.q: Six persons Asad, Danish, Hina, Mehwish, Sara, Waqar sit around a circular table, all facing the centre. Asad sits immediately to the right of Danish. Sara sits second to the left of Danish. Waqar sits exactly opposite Hina. Hina is not an immediate neighbour of Danish. Who sits second to the left of Mehwish?
q.e: Fix one person, then place the others using 'immediate', 'opposite' and 'second to' clues; left and right are taken from the seated person's own view (facing the centre).

q.q: 6 students Ayesha, Faraz, Kamran, Sadia, Salman, Waqar each have a test on a different day, from Monday to Saturday (one test per day). Kamran's test is held earlier in the week than Sadia's. Sadia's test is neither on the first nor on the last day. Exactly 4 days separate Waqar's test and Ayesha's. Exactly 3 days separate Sadia's test and Ayesha's. Ayesha's and Salman's tests are not on consecutive days. Kamran's and Salman's tests are on consecutive days. Exactly 2 days separate Sadia's test and Kamran's. On which day is Faraz's test held?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.

q.q: 6 friends Asad, Bilal, Faraz, Hina, Imran, Salman sit in a row facing north. Hina sits somewhere between Imran and Salman. Asad does not sit next to Salman. Imran sits somewhere to the left of Salman. There are exactly 2 persons between Hina and Salman. Imran sits immediately to the left of Asad. Bilal sits somewhere between Faraz and Hina. Who sits at the fourth place from the left end?
q.e: Place the definite clues first (immediate neighbours, ends), then use the 'between' and 'left of' clues to fix the rest; the arrangement is unique.
